ios.desc:
Understand books more deeply.

BooksMe is a quiet space for readers who want to capture what stands out, reflect on what they read, and revisit the ideas that matter.

Instead of just finishing books, BooksMe helps you remember what stayed with you.

## Capture while you read

Save quotes, thoughts, and insights from the books you're reading.

Add an optional reflection to capture what the idea made you think about.

## Revisit what mattered

BooksMe brings your saved ideas back over time so they don't disappear after you finish a book.

Open Today to revisit ideas you've captured before.

## Keep your reading organized

Add the books you're currently reading and the books you've finished.

Each book keeps the ideas and reflections you've captured from it in one place.

## Gentle reading reminders

Set an optional daily reminder for a book you're reading.

A simple nudge can help you return to the book and capture anything worth remembering.

## Designed for thoughtful reading

BooksMe is built to support reading, not replace it.

No feeds. No book summaries. No endless scrolling.

Just a calm place to read, capture, reflect, and revisit.

BooksMe is free to use.
